meta.study: autospec held-out loss and time by fit budget (mboostrs.fit budget mapping)
meta.code_note: measured autospec at this commit; the commit recording these results changes only mboostrs.fit and its trail, not autospec
meta.threads: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 per process; five processes ran concurrently
meta.splits: benches/shootout_data.py payload(task, seed): fit+validation rows (capped at 4,000) for autospec, test rows (capped at 2,000) for scoring
meta.loss: test MSE (regression) or log loss (binary panels credit, cancer)
meta.warmup: none; the first fit in each process includes module import time
